raw.description:
Remerge helps leading mobile app marketers increase revenue and retention by activating, re-engaging and retaining high-value users through programmatic in-app ads. Founded in 2014, Remerge has established itself as a leading app retargeting player globally, with offices spanning Berlin, New York, Singapore, Seoul and Tokyo. Our international team of experts has contributed to the growth of hundreds of apps across all major verticals, including gaming, on-demand delivery, e-commerce, and finance.

We are looking for a pragmatic, curious, and AI-fluent Machine Learning Engineer to join our Performance team. Beyond core ML, our work touches a range of disciplines like reinforcement learning, control engineering, mathematical optimization, and causal inference, to name a few. If you already have depth in any of these, great; if not, there's plenty of interesting territory to explore alongside the core ML work.

About the Team

The Performance team is the brain behind our bidding infrastructure. We handle the core algorithms responsible for maximizing ad performance and optimizing return on ad spend (ROAS) within the strict parameters set by our advertisers. We run a hybrid setup; training in the cloud and inference on our own hardware. That mix gives us the freedom to push the boundaries of high-throughput ML, while keeping us honest about the cost and scale trade-offs of doing so. We have a pragmatic view about what 'ML' means here; feature pipelines, online serving, and monitoring are part of the job, not someone else's problem.

In this role you will...

  • Develop & Scale ML Models: Build, train, and deploy high-performance machine learning prediction models optimized for real-time adtech environments.
  • Own the Full ML Path: Take models from raw data and feature definitions through training, evaluation, and online serving. Feature engineering and online/offline consistency matter as much as modelling skill.
  • Optimize the Bidding Engine: Design and refine complex bidding algorithms, orchestrating how multiple models interact together in milliseconds to make optimal final bidding decisions.
  • Run & Analyze Experiments: Design, execute, and evaluate both offline simulations and online A/B tests to measure and analyze algorithmic impact on core business metrics.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Step outside the traditional ML silo to collaborate with engineering and product partners, adapting quickly to diverse technical challenges.
  • Augment Your Workflow: Actively integrate new AI tools and coding agents into your daily process to maximize throughput, experiment velocity, and code quality.

You will be a great fit if...

  • Technical Stack: You have strong proficiency in Python and TensorFlow for building ML models, and comfortable reading Go to navigate our online serving services, this would be easy to pick up if you already know Python.
  • Growth Mindset: Beyond core ML, our work touches a range of disciplines like reinforcement learning, control engineering, mathematical optimisation, and causal inference, to name a few. If you already have depth in any of these, great; if not, there's plenty of interesting territory to explore alongside the core ML work.
  • Healthy Skepticism & Pragmatism: You don't just build complex models because they are trendy; you use data-driven analysis to find the most pragmatic solution to the problem at hand.
  • Ownership Mindset: You are adaptable and thrive when given the autonomy to take a project from early-stage experimentation all the way through to production.
  • AI-Forward: You possess a genuine curiosity about the evolution of AI and are enthusiastic about leveraging AI coding tools to optimize your engineering workflows.

Our promise

  • Unlimited vacation days - for real. We give you the freedom to figure out the most productive work-life balance for you
  • A truly modern place to work: work from home, from our brand new office in Berlin, or remotely - your work environment is yours to design
  • Generous remuneration package including virtual shares, a dedicated education budget
  • End of the year bonus determined by company performance
  • Enrol in our Short Term Assignment (STA) program and travel to our offices around the globe for up to a month - subject to eligibility and internal policy
  • Comfortable work setup - laptop, phone, screen(s), standing desk etc.
  • Support for your setup while working from home
  • Wellness benefits such as sports memberships, Nilo Health subscription and internet reimbursements
  • Company events including breakfast twice a week, team lunches, birthday and milestone celebrations, quarterly team events and company-wide parties & trips

Remerge is an Equal Opportunity Employer: all qualified applicants are considered for positions regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, age, religion or belief, marital status, gender identification, sexual orientation, veteran status or disability. We're looking forward to your application!

Important notice: Protect yourself from scammers representing Remerge

Do not respond to job offers from third parties claiming to recruit on behalf of Remerge, or individuals impersonating as Remerge employees offering freelance or remote work opportunities. We do not ask job applicants for personal information like bank account numbers, address, money transfer requests, or other confidential details on any messaging platform. If someone reaches out to you to offer you a job, make sure that they are a verified Remerge employee by checking their identity on official Remerge channels.

Please note that the only job openings we offer are listed on our official website:

Stay vigilant and protect yourself from potential scams.

Please review our Applicants Privacy Policy.

raw.description:
EMCD is a global technology leader in the crypto industry, best known as the #1 mining pool in Eastern Europe and a Top-10 mining pool worldwide. We are expanding globally and building a comprehensive ecosystem of crypto services, including payment infrastructure, custody, mining solutions and enterprise-grade tools for businesses and institutions. As part of our expansion, we are developing white-label solutions that allow partners to launch scalable, secure and high-performance fintech and blockchain products.

We are looking for a senior-level Head of Organizational Effectiveness who will build and drive the company's performance ecosystem across the entire organisation.

This is not a traditional HRBP or People Partner role. The position sits at the intersection of Organizational Effectiveness, Performance Management, OKR/KPI Governance, and Total Rewards, with direct exposure to the CEO and executive leadership team.

Your Mission

Build and scale a company-wide performance management framework that aligns business goals, leadership accountability, compensation strategy, and organisational execution.

You will own the design and implementation of performance operating systems, governance processes, incentive programs, and leadership accountability frameworks that support EMCD's next stage of growth.

What You Will Do

Performance Management & Organizational Effectiveness

  • Design and implement company-wide OKR and KPI frameworks.
  • Establish performance governance processes, performance reviews, and leadership calibration practices.
  • Improve organizational alignment, accountability, and execution discipline.
  • Drive visibility into business performance and strategic priorities.
  • Build scalable frameworks that support organisational growth and operational maturity.

Compensation, Incentives & Rewards

  • Design and evolve LTI, bonus, incentive, and retention programs.
  • Align compensation philosophy with business outcomes and performance metrics.
  • Partner with Finance and leadership teams on reward strategy and workforce effectiveness.
  • Ensure performance and compensation systems reinforce company objectives and long-term value creation.

Leadership Partnership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the CEO and leadership team on organisational performance and effectiveness.
  • Facilitate discussions around accountability, priorities, execution risks, and organisational health.
  • Challenge leadership constructively and drive alignment when needed.
  • Support business leaders in making performance-driven decisions.

Analytics & Performance Insights

  • Develop performance dashboards, reporting frameworks, and governance metrics.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of OKRs, KPIs, and incentive programs.
  • Identify organisational bottlenecks, execution risks, and performance gaps.
  • Introduce data-driven approaches to improve operational clarity and decision-making.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience building and scaling performance management systems in technology, fintech, SaaS, or crypto companies.
  • Strong expertise in OKRs, KPIs, performance governance, and leadership calibration.
  • Deep understanding of Total Rewards, LTI programs, incentive design, and performance-linked compensation.
  • Experience working directly with founders, CEOs, or executive leadership teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to influence, challenge, and align senior leaders.
  • High ownership, strong business acumen, and structured problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-growth, and ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in crypto, fintech, or global technology companies.
  • Organisational design and workforce effectiveness expertise.
  • Consulting background combined with in-house leadership experience.
  • Experience driving company-wide transformation and scaling initiatives.

What We Offer:

  • Remote-first company - work from anywhere in the world
  • Fully flexible working hour
  • Extended time off: 20 paid vacation days + 12 bonus days per year
  • 100% paid sick leave
  • Paid English lessons (iTalki)
  • Professional growth support (courses, certifications, training programs)
  • Real impact and ownership in fintech & crypto projects
  • Corporate benefits: EMCD product discounts and mining infrastructure access
  • Salary in USDT
  • Employment via Service Agreement

Senior Software / Cloud Engineer

Location: Remote (Within the US)
Employment Type: Long-term Contract


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software / Cloud Engineer to lead the migration of legacy systems and the modernization of mission-critical APIs. This role is essential in ensuring our infrastructure aligns with IT General Controls (ITGC) standards. You will focus on building audit-ready, future-proof data pipelines and modernizing our commissions API into a tokenized, reportable structure that supports seamless integration with new enterprise solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Migration & Modernization

  • System Integration: Lead the migration of legacy systems to integrate directly with new enterprise solutions, ensuring minimal downtime and data integrity.
  • API Modernization: Design and deliver a modernized commissions API, implementing a tokenized and reportable structure that meets strict ITGC standards.
  • Audit Readiness: Ensure all data transfers and API designs are secure and accurately documented to support internal and external audit requirements.

Architecture & Development

  • Hands-on Engineering: Provide expert-level coding support for both new and existing systems, primarily using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Architecture Design: Contribute to high-level architectural discussions, offering insights on scalability, security, and cloud-native best practices.
  • Data Pipelines: Build and maintain resilient data pipelines to facilitate accurate data transfer across cross-functional platforms.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Cross-functional Coordination: Work closely with internal teams to support their transition to new solutions and ensure data requirements are met across the organization.
  • Technical Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert in collaborative environments involving multiple stakeholders and diverse technical teams.

Required Technical Skills

  • Core Development: 7–10 years of overall software development experience with a mastery of Java.
  • Frameworks: Extensive experience building and integrating RESTful APIs using Spring Boot.
  • Backend Polyglot: Proficiency with Golang for backend service development.
  • AWS Cloud Stack: Hands-on experience with AWS technologies, specifically:
  • ECS / Fargate for container orchestration.
  • CloudFormation for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • SQS & Lambda for serverless and event-driven architectures.
  • Containerization: Strong familiarity with Docker and related containerization tools.
  • Compliance Knowledge: Understanding of ITGC (IT General Controls) and how to build systems that are "audit-ready."

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Applicants must be active-duty U.S. Military Members who qualify for the DoD SkillBridge Program.
To Apply:
1. Go toand complete the SkillBridge interest form.
2. Return to this posting and click 'Apply'.
Duration:90–180 days
Overview:
Apex Systems isseeking motivated service members to participate in our IT/Cybersecurity SkillBridge Internship Program. This program provides structured technical training, industry-recognized certifications, and meaningful networking experiences to support a smooth transition into civilian IT careers.
Interns will spend 50% of their time developing technical skills through Apex’s training platform and 50% networking with other transitioning service members who are exploring IT career pathways. These peer conversations help interns build a strong professional network, gain real‑world career insights, and learn from the experiences of other veterans navigating the IT job market.
The overall goal of the internship is to prepare participants for post‑service careers across Apex’s IT practice areas—networking, cloud, cybersecurity, engineering, helpdesk, and more.
Company Website:
Responsibilities:
1. Technical Certification Training (50% of the day)
Participate in self-paced IT and cybersecurity training toward certifications such as:
  • CompTIA Security+
  • CEH
  • CCNA
  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
  • Azure-900
  • CISSP
  • CySA+
  • Linux+
  • CISM
  • CCNP
  • Prepare for and sit for certification exams using Apex’s training resources.
2. Peer Networking & Veteran Engagement (50% of the day)
  • Connect with other transitioning service members who are exploring or entering IT career fields.
  • Participate in peer-to-peer conversations to share experiences, lessons learned, and available resources.
  • Help fellow veterans understand SkillBridge opportunities, IT career pathways, and transition tools.
  • Build a professional network that supports long-term career growth and job exploration.
  • Serve as a resource for new SkillBridge participants by sharing insights on study strategies, certifications, and navigating civilian IT roles.
  • Residents will serve as a liaison between veterans exploring civilian IT roles, and the Apex teams that support hiring and career development.
  • This networking component enables interns to learn from the transition journeys of their peers, strengthen communication skills, and expand their professional footprint within the IT sector.
3. Onboarding & Transition Support
  • Take part in program onboarding, goal setting, and mentorship activities.
  • Attend professional development touchpoints with Apex team members.
  • Complete out-processing activities and interview for full-time roles with Apex Systems or partner employers.
Qualifications
  • Active-duty U.S. military and SkillBridge eligible.
  • Active Secret clearance or higher (minimum).
  • Security+ certification or relevant IT experience with a desire to obtain certifications during the internship.
  • Willingness to work in Washington, DC, or another Apex location post-internship (to be discussed during intake). This WILL NOT be a remote job if hired after the internship.
  • Strong self-discipline and ability to manage a remote, self-paced schedule.
  • Interest in pursuing a career in IT, cybersecurity, or technical support roles.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Motivation to support peers and actively participate in networking.
  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
Benefits
  • Opportunity to earn industry-recognized IT certifications.
  • Hands-on training that aligns with in-demand technical roles.
  • Meaningful professional networking with other transitioning veterans.
  • Mentorship from Apex technical and career-development professionals.
  • Enhanced soft skills including communication, collaboration, and career navigation.
  • Contribution to the broader military/veteran community.
Vets2PM Provides:
  • Mentorship and guidance via regular SkillBridge intern Zoom Meetings.

Revenue Analyst

Colombia

Remote

The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei, the Canadian fintech company accelerating the business of clients around the world. Nuvei's modular, flexible and scalable technology allows leading companies to accept next-gen payments, offer all payout options and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 50 markets, 150 currencies and 700 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally with one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission

We are looking for a Revenue Analyst to join our fast-growing Merchant Pricing & Analysis team. Reporting to our MP&A Billing Manager, you will be supporting the team in executing manual billing processes and implementing pricing updates, with strong emphasis on data accuracy, validation, and analysis to support revenue integrity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enter, validate, and analyze pricing and fee structures to ensure accuracy and completeness
  • Calculate and support monthly manual billing processes, including data uploads
  • Analyze pricing strategies and recommend solutions to drive profitability and support revenue growth
  • Build, maintain, and QA billing configurations and pricing models
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies and reporting variances
  • Assess the financial impact of billing changes, corrections, and new initiatives
  • Respond to escalations from Operations, Product, and Sales teams in a timely manner
  • Ensure compliance with SOX controls and internal policies
  • Develop and maintain process documentation and standard operating procedures
  • Identify and implement opportunities for process improvements and automation
  • Support quarterly card brand enhancements and related pricing updates
  • Identify financial risks and communicate potential impacts
  • Take ownership of monthly billing activities, including issue identification, impact analysis, and process updates
  • Provide ad hoc analysis and support to the Merchant Pricing & Analysis team as needed

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of related experience in billing, pricing, finance, or a similar analytical role
  • Strong attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy in data entry, validation, and financial calculations
  • Experience with data validation and identifying discrepancies in financial or billing data
  • Comfortable calculating and analyzing financial impacts of changes, issues, and updates
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency as a requirement
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and consistently meet tight deadlines
  • Self-starter with a high level of initiative and ownership over assigned responsibilities
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team
  • Strong sense of accountability for completing high-impact manual billing activities accurately and on time
  • Proven ability to take ownership of tasks from start to finish, including validation and issue resolution
  • Driven to learn, ask questions, and continuously improve processes and understanding of the business
  • Inquisitive mindset with the ability to identify issues, dig into root causes, and propose solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain findings and issues

Benefits

Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can’t wait to meet you.

Our recruitment process may use automated tools, including AI, to support application management and candidate shortlisting.

This is a remote role within a global team that utilizes cutting-edge technology to stay connected with colleagues worldwide. Occasional travel to a local office may be required for in-person collaboration with your team, as well as for company events, team building activities, or strategic meetings.

Being a Director, Account Management, Law at iManage Means…

You are a strategic revenue leader responsible for driving sustained, scalable growth across a small & mid law segment. You lead with clarity and accountability, building high-performance sales organizations that consistently exceed targets. You set the vision for execution, create alignment across functions, and ensure our go-to-market motion evolves as the market evolves.

This role carries full ownership of segment revenue performance, forecasting accuracy, talent development, and strategic market expansion. Your leadership directly impacts company growth, competitive positioning, and long-term customer value.

At iManage, sales leadership is measured by how you elevate Talent, shape Strategy, drive Collaboration, and execute with Operational rigor. This role sits at the center of that mandate.

iM Responsible For…

Revenue Strategy and Market Growth

  • Own segment-level revenue targets across new business and expansion
  • Build and execute multi-quarter growth plans aligned to company's objectives
  • Design territory coverage and resource allocation models to maximize market penetration
  • Identify whitespace opportunities and expand strategic accounts
  • Strengthen executive-level customer relationships to accelerate large, complex deals
  • Partner with Product and Marketing to refine positioning based on market feedback and competitive insight

Building and Developing High-Performance Teams

  • Lead and develop Sales Managers and senior sellers
  • Recruit, hire, and build bench strength for long-term scalability
  • Establish clear performance expectations and accountability standards
  • Coach leaders on pipeline inspection, deal strategy, and talent development
  • Drive succession planning across the organization

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with RevOps to improve forecasting models and reporting accuracy
  • Align with Marketing on demand generation, regional strategy, and campaign execution
  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Professional Services to drive expansion and long-term value
  • Work closely with Partner leadership to increase partner-sourced pipeline
  • Influence pricing, packaging, and go-to-market innovation

Sales Execution and Operating Discipline

  • Lead forecast calls, QBRs, territory planning, and pipeline governance
  • Ensure consistent use of sales methodology across qualification and closing
  • Improve funnel conversion through data-driven inspection and enablement
  • Drive forecasting accuracy and predictable revenue performance
  • Maintain clear executive visibility into pipeline health and segment performance

iM Qualified Because I Have…

  • 10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales with significant leadership responsibility.
  • Proven experience leading managers or senior sellers within a high-growth, enterprise-focused environment.
  • A demonstrated track record of owning and exceeding regional or segment-level revenue targets.
  • Experience driving forecast accuracy and operational discipline at scale.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage C-level stakeholders internally and externally.
  • Deep experience diagnosing performance trends and adjusting go-to-market strategy accordingly.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership across Marketing, RevOps, Product, Customer Success, and Partner organizations

Bonus Points If I Have...

  • Experience in Legal Tech SaaS.
  • Experience selling or positioning AI-driven technologies.
  • Experience scaling sales organizations during periods of rapid growth or transformation.

The overall US annual base salary range for this position is $194,000 - $220,000. Individual compensation for each candidate depends on factors such as qualifications, experience, and candidate location. This range does not include additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commission, or benefits. Your recruiter will provide further details about the offer range, incentives, and overall compensation during the hiring process.

Don't meet every qualification listed above? Studies show that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet all qualifications. At iManage, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment, and encourage everyone to show up as their full authentic selves. We welcome those that come with a growth mindset and a hunger for learning; so, if you are excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification we encourage you to apply anyways!

iM Getting To…

  • Join a rapidly evolving, industry-leading SaaS company on an exciting journey of growth and scalability! 
  • Take on meaningful, high-impact challenges by leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best-in-class protocols to drive innovation. 
  • Own my career path with our internal development framework. Ask us more about this! 
  • Expand my skill set and earn certifications with unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning courses and interactive Microsoft courses & training. 
  • Be part of a supportive and experienced team within a dynamic, inclusive, and encouraging culture. 
  • Enjoy flexible work hours that empower me to balance personal time with professional commitments. 
  • Collaborate in a modern, open-plan workspace featuring a gaming area, free snacks and drinks, and regular social events. 

iManage Is Supporting Me By...

  • Creating an inclusive environment where I can help shape the culture not just by fitting in, but by adding to it.
  • Providing a market competitive salary that is applied through a consistent process, equitable for all our employees, and regularly reviewed based on industry data.
  • Rewarding me with an annual sales commission plan
  • Offering comprehensive Health/Vision/Dental/Life Insurance, and a 401k Retirement Savings Plan with a company match up to 4%.
  • Granting enhanced leave for expecting parents; 20 weeks 100% paid for primary leave, and 10 weeks 100% paid for secondary leave.
  • Providing me with a flexible time off policy to take the time off that I need. Be it for vacation, volunteering, celebrating holidays, spending time with family, or simply taking time to recharge and reset.
  • Having multiple company wellness days each year to prioritize mental health and well-being. 
  • Providing access to RethinkCare, a global behavioral health platform that enhances personal well-being, strengthens professional resilience, and empowers parental success through expert-led training and resources. 

iManage is committed to providing an excellent candidate experience and will never ask you to engage in recruitment activity via text and exclusively communicates from emails using the @imanage.com domain. If you have any concerns or questions about communications you have received, please send them to so our team members can review.

About iManage…

At iManage, we are dedicated to Making Knowledge Work™. Our intelligent, cloud-enabled, and secure platform is trusted by 4,100+ customers and 430,000 users worldwide, managing over 11 billion documents and 11 petabytes of data. We empower professionals across 65+ countries to unlock the full potential of their business content and communications. 

We are continuously innovating to solve the most complex professional challenges and enable better business outcomes; Our work is not always easy but it is ambitious and rewarding.

So we’re looking for people who embrace challenges. People who thrive on solving problems, pushing boundaries, and collaborating with the industry’s best and brightest. That’s the iManage way. It’s how we turn the impossible into reality, empower our employees to grow, unlock their potential, and create a meaningful impact on everything we do. 

Whoever you are, whatever you do, however you work. Make it mean something at iManage.

A subsidiary of a renowned real estate developer, this company is behind one of Colombo's premier mixed-use developments, including a state-of-the-art lifestyle mall. Spanning over 200,000 square feet, the mall offers an unparalleled range of shopping, entertainment, and dining experiences, setting a new standard for urban living. Join this prestigious organization to be part of its innovative journey.

About the Role:

The AI & Process Automation Executive/Analyst will lead and coordinate group-wide automation and digital transformation initiatives. The role focuses on identifying process improvement opportunities, implementing AI-driven solutions, optimizing workflows, and delivering actionable insights to enhance operational efficiency, tenant performance, and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate asset-specific AI and process automation initiatives across the group.
  • Identify automation opportunities and map internal workflows to improve efficiency.
  • Collaborate closely with IT teams and vendors to design, implement, and maintain automation solutions.
  • Drive user adoption and measure efficiency gains, manpower optimization, and ROI.
  • Utilize AI tools for analytics automation, reporting, and enhanced tenant/customer insights.
  • Document processes, develop SOPs, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor system performance and recommend enhancements.
  • Analyze tenant categories, track performance, benchmark top/bottom performers, and support churn reduction strategies.
  • Support development of Tenant Satisfaction Index (TSI) and Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) through surveys and digital tools.

Job Overview
Perform monitoring and site management work to ensure that sites are conducting the study(ies) and reporting study data as required by the study protocol, applicable regulations and guidelines, and sponsor requirements.

Essential Functions
• Perform site monitoring visits (selection, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits) in accordance with contracted scope of work and Good Clinical Practice.

As a ServiceLink Staff Appraiser, you’ll perform desktop and field appraisal assignments and quality control reviews consistent with established client-driven turn times and high-quality standards.

This opportunity offers excellent pay, full benefits, company-paid continuing education, and more.

WHY SERVICELINK?

What we offer…

  • Highly Competitive Pay Structure: Staff Appraisers receive guaranteed base pay, plus generous order level compensation for every order completed, providing the perfect mix of reliable pay and uncapped earning potential
  • Full Benefits: ServiceLink offers a comprehensive benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision, 401K w/ company match, Stock Purchase Plan w/ company match, and more

conversion rate and post-checkout monetization through relentless UX experimentation and data-driven iteration. In parallel, own the payments infrastructure layer: maintaining high authorization rates, reducing chargebacks and declines, and evolving our multi-PSP strategy as the business scales internationally. This role sits at the intersection of growth, product, engineering, finance, and

customer care - and its success is measured in revenue recovered, conversion rate lifted, and offers accepted.

  • Own the end-to-end TrafiCheckout funnel across all brands (Shapermint, Shaperbox, Truekind): from cart entry through order confirmation, on desktop and mobile.

  • Hands-on experience with Stripe at a product ownership level: authorization rate optimization, retry logic, 3DS configuration, Radar fraud rules, and dashboard-level diagnostics

  • Experience managing or integrating multiple PSPs and digital wallets (PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay) simultaneously — including UX placement, conversion measurement, and decline management

  • Ownership of post-checkout monetization architecture: upsell, downsell, and fallback offer flows, subscription offers at checkout, and payment recovery or dunning sequences with measured revenue impact

  • Ability to diagnose checkout drop-off by device, traffic source, payment method, and error type — distinguishing UX friction from payment infrastructure issues using session recordings, funnel analytics, and heatmaps

  • Familiarity with fraud prevention tools, chargeback management processes, and subscription billing compliance basics including FTC negative option and ROSCA requirements

  • Strong cross-functional influence — able to align Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Customer Care around checkout decisions and present performance results and strategic roadmap directly to CMO or C-level stakeholders

Role Summary

The Chief Blockchain Officer (CBO) is responsible for defining and executing the organization's blockchain, distributed ledger technology (DLT), digital asset, and Web3 strategy. This executive role leads the development of blockchain-based products, tokenization initiatives, decentralized finance (DeFi) opportunities, smart contract ecosystems, and enterprise blockchain adoption to drive innovation, operational efficiency, and new revenue streams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Blockchain Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the organization's blockchain and digital asset strategy.
  • Identify opportunities for blockchain adoption across products, operations, and customer experiences.
  • Advise the CEO, Board, and executive leadership on blockchain trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Establish the organization's vision for Web3, tokenization, and decentralized ecosystems.

2. Blockchain Product Development

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of blockchain-based products and platforms.
  • Oversee smart contract architecture and decentralized application (dApp) development.
  • Drive tokenization initiatives for assets, payments, loyalty programs, and financial products.
  • Ensure scalable, secure, and compliant blockchain solutions.

3. Digital Assets & Token Economy

  • Develop strategies for digital assets, token ecosystems, and cryptocurrency integration where applicable.
  • Design tokenomics models and governance structures.
  • Evaluate opportunities for digital asset custody, trading, settlement, and asset management.
  • Assess emerging trends in stablecoins, CBDCs, and tokenized assets.

4. Enterprise Blockchain & Innovation

  • Lead enterprise blockchain initiatives across supply chain, identity, payments, trade finance, and record management.
  • Evaluate and implement blockchain platforms such as Hyperledger Fabric, Ethereum, and other distributed ledger technologies.
  • Drive proof-of-concept programs and innovation labs.
  • Promote blockchain adoption across business units.

5. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure blockchain initiatives comply with applicable financial, technology, and data regulations.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Cybersecurity teams.
  • Manage risks associated with smart contracts, digital assets, and decentralized systems.
  • Establish governance frameworks for blockchain operations.

6. Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development

  • Build partnerships with blockchain networks, fintechs, technology providers, regulators, and industry consortiums.
  • Represent the organization in blockchain alliances and industry forums.
  • Identify opportunities for ecosystem expansion and interoperability.
  • Lead blockchain-related investments and strategic collaborations.

7. Cybersecurity & Blockchain Governance

  • Ensure security and resilience of blockchain infrastructure and smart contracts.
  • Implement governance frameworks for blockchain networks and decentralized applications.
  • Oversee smart contract audits, security assessments, and vulnerability management.
  • Establish best practices for digital asset protection and key management.

8. Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Build and lead high-performing blockchain engineering, product, and innovation teams.
  • Develop blockchain capabilities across the organization.
  • Manage blockchain budgets, investments, and vendor relationships.
  • Foster a culture of innovation and emerging technology adoption.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Finance, or related field.
  • Master's degree, MBA, or relevant advanced qualification preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in technology, fintech, digital innovation, financial services, or blockchain-related fields.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a senior leadership role.
  • Proven experience leading blockchain, digital asset, Web3, or distributed ledger initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of smart contracts, tokenization, digital assets, cryptography, and blockchain architecture.

Key Competencies

  • Blockchain & Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)
  • Web3 Strategy & Innovation
  • Digital Assets & Tokenization
  • Smart Contracts & dApps
  • Decentralized Finance (DeFi)
  • Enterprise Blockchain Solutions
  • Blockchain Governance & Compliance
  • Cybersecurity & Risk Management
  • Product Innovation & Commercialization
  • Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development
  • Executive Leadership
  • Emerging Technology Strategy

raw.title: Capture Manager – US Government Contracts
raw.excerpt: Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery.
raw.description:
Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery. Our mission is to deliver high-resolution thermal insights that help governments, defense agencies, agribusinesses, and other decision-makers better manage water, agriculture, climate resilience, and critical infrastructure.

With operations in the United States and Luxembourg, Hydrosat combines cutting-edge satellite technology, geospatial analytics, and applied science to turn raw Earth observation data into actionable intelligence. Our U.S. team plays a central role in government and defense market development, commercial growth, and delivering scalable solutions for federal, civil, and commercial customers. We are looking for bright, ambitious, and collaborative people who want to help transform how space-based data is used in the real world.

Hydrosat is seeking a Capture Manager – US Government Contracts to own the full capture lifecycle for U.S. government opportunities - from early market shaping and customer engagement through competitive positioning, proposal development, and award. This role spans federal civilian agencies, defense programs, SBIR/STTR solicitations, Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs), and commercial contract bids.

This person will proactively identify, qualify, and shape new business opportunities across federal and defense markets - not just respond to solicitations, but actively seek out whitespace and emerging programs before they hit the street. You will translate Hydrosat’s technical, scientific, and commercial capabilities into compelling, compliant, and strategically positioned submissions, working cross-functionally with engineering, science, product, business development, finance, and leadership teams to own the pipeline end-to-end: from independent opportunity sourcing through award and follow-up.

This role is ideal for someone who understands both the language of space and Earth observation and the discipline of U.S. government proposal development - and who can operate effectively across the full federal and commercial procurement landscape.

Responsibilities

  • Proactively identify, research, and qualify new business opportunities independently across SAM.gov, GovWin, agency forecasts, industry intelligence sources, and direct customer engagement - without waiting for opportunities to be handed down; build and manage a robust pursuit pipeline, lead bid/no-bid assessments, and maintain accurate probability-of-win (Pwin) tracking across active pursuits.

  • Conduct independent market research and competitive landscape analysis to surface emerging programs, early-stage procurements, and adjacent whitespace opportunities - translating findings into concrete go/no-go recommendations and early capture strategies for leadership.

  • Engage federal agency program offices, contracting officers, and key government stakeholders pre-solicitation to shape requirements, position Hydrosat’s capabilities, and build the relationships that influence RFP structure and evaluation criteria.

  • Develop and execute capture plans for priority opportunities, including win strategy, competitive analysis, black hat reviews, and differentiated value proposition development aligned to customer mission priorities.

  • Represent Hydrosat at industry days, conferences, and customer meetings; respond to RFIs and draft white papers to establish visibility and credibility in target markets ahead of formal solicitations.

  • Lead proposals end-to-end once a pursuit is committed, from final strategy alignment through drafting, coordination, submission, and debrief follow-up; ensure win themes developed during capture are woven throughout the submission.

  • Write and refine clear, persuasive proposal content across technical, management, past performance, and cost/price volumes.

  • Coordinate inputs from cross-functional teams including engineering, science, product, finance, and business development.

  • Develop and own key proposal elements: PWS/SOO responses, technical approaches, management plans, staffing narratives, schedules, and risk sections.

  • Ensure full compliance with solicitation requirements (RFP, RFI, BAA, SBIR/STTR) including agency-specific instructions.

  • Support teaming and subcontractor coordination, including NDAs, workshare agreements, and partner input integration.

  • Build and maintain reusable proposal content, win themes, past performance narratives, and templates to improve quality and efficiency.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in capture management or business development for U.S. government contracts (federal civilian, DoW, or IC), with a demonstrated ability to independently identify and qualify opportunities and a track record of wins across the full capture lifecycle.

  • Demonstrated experience developing capture plans, conducting competitive analysis, and shaping opportunities pre-RFP; proven ability to manage complex, multi-volume submissions and translate technical content into compelling proposal narratives.

  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal procurement processes and proposal structure (e.g., Shipley or equivalent methodology).

  • Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders under tight solicitation deadlines.

  • Excellent written English and strong skills in proposal writing.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (communications, technical writing, engineering, policy, or similar).

Nice to Have

  • Experience with NASA, NOAA, NRO, NGA, DoW, USGS, USDA, U.S. Department of Interior, or DHS solicitations.

🇿🇦 Up to ZAR 500,000 salary on a full time, permanent employment contract
🌎 Fully remote working anywhere in South Africa!

🏖️ 33 Days Paid Leave and Benefits

✨ Exciting high growth product, relied on by leading global brands, particularly within sports
💻 Working with the latest hardware, tech stack, AI tools, and product workflows

About The Roles

These are broad, owned roles for operators who go and find the work rather than waiting to be handed it. You'll take hold of real problems, own them outright and have the remit to solve them without being blocked.

Whether you're early in your career or have done this before – we have roles at varying levels, what matters is that you make things happen.

​​About Us

Storyteller is a high growth B2B SaaS platform, which allows companies to integrate Stories into their owned and operated platforms. Popularized by Instagram and Snapchat, Stories are perfectly suited for boosting user engagement, audience retention, and driving advertising revenue.

Our end‑to‑end platform gives companies a best‑in‑class Stories experience in days with native iOS, Android, and Web SDKs, publishing tools, analytics, and ad support.

We work with many globally recognised clients, particularly within sport, so if you're a sporting fan this could be a great fit!


The Kind Of Work Across These Roles

Not one person does all of this - it's a spread of what the operations function owns, and where you fit depends on your level and strengths. As examples:

  • Hiring. Running recruitment end to end: innovating, using the latest technology, moving quickly, and not letting strong candidates go cold.
  • Product operations. Getting our software set up and running across clients efficiently and effectively, standing up proof-of-concepts on request, and being the person who actually understands how it works when something breaks.
  • Front-line client work. Getting on calls with the people using our products, interrogating how they're actually using it, digging into what's landing and what isn't, and handling support directly rather than routing it onward.
  • Models and the AI stack. We’re AI first and new models land constantly. Running evals, deciding whether we adopt or switch, and keeping us on the right tooling rather than the default.
  • Infrastructure and cost. SaaS, AI, and cloud billing - owning what we spend, finding the waste, and cutting it. We treat every line item as negotiable.

Who We Are After

We care more about the person than any specific list above, which will change. We're hiring for ceiling and raw ability.

You're a doer who moves things. You're comfortable owning ambiguity and you'd rather ship something rough and improve it than write a plan about shipping it later. You can talk to a developer, read a billing dashboard, run an eval, and take a client call in the same week - and you're already using AI to move faster.

You might have built or run something of your own - a startup, a small business, a product, a team - or worked somewhere fast/high growth where the scope was undefined and you liked it that way.


We're Open At More Than One Level

More junior: you run the day-to-day machinery under direction - setting up and supporting the software across clients, standing up proof-of-concepts, handling front-line support, doing the legwork on model evals. Sharp, technical, fast, hungry to take on more.

More senior: you own a remit and set the direction - hiring and line management, client relationships, cost and infrastructure. You've carried this kind of breadth before.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • An initial call with a member of the Operations team.
  • A compensated exercise to test skills relevant to the role(s).
  • Final interview with another member of the team.

And that’s it!

Privacy Notice
We process your personal data for recruitment purposes in line with UK data protection law. AI tools may assist in reviewing applications, but decisions are made by our team. We retain data only as necessary for recruitment and compliance. You can request access or deletion of your data at any time by emailing .

raw.description:
Who We Are:

We are an insurance technology and distribution platform that is transforming the industry. We have developed a paperless, data driven underwriting process that allows us to issue policies in less than one minute. We are one of the top distributors of digital life insurance policies in the world. We have an in-house marketing team that is generating exclusive client requests for our advisors. We are the only organization in the industry that owns both the technology platform and the distribution channels. We will gross more than $250 million in premiums this year and we are valued at more than $3 billion.

Our Vision:

We are transforming the life insurance industry with technology and business systems that create a frictionless experience for clients and provide cutting edge tools to our advisors.

Client Acquisition:

We have our own in-house marketing team that generates approximately 20,000 new client requests per week, exclusively for our advisors. We use a data driven approach that is constantly fine-tuned to find and be found by motivated clients who have a need and desire to buy life insurance.

Our system includes targeted direct mail and digital content that goes out to homeowners. Those homeowners who are interested in what we offer will personally respond through an online link, scanning a QR code on the direct mail piece, or by calling in and requesting us to contact them and set a virtual appointment over zoom to review their options. There is no cold calling. Only those who have requested the information will be contacted. Our system is very effective allowing many of our advisors to earn over $120k in the first year regardless of experience.

Client Fulfillment:

As a client advisor you will have access to our technology driven CRM to connect with clients who have requested a consultation, the automation will set a virtual appointment from home or anywhere to help them apply for the best plan for their needs. The system will send a calendar event with a one-click link to connect for the virtual meeting. Our full-time advisors will connect with 10 to 15 families per week. We provide ongoing training and support for our advisor partners. Some of our advisors start on a part-time basis and gradually move to full-time.

In addition to generating client requests, we have created a Direct-to-Consumer platform for independent insurance advisors to leverage. What is it? A Direct-to-Consumer platform allows clients to buy an insurance policy on their own, from their desktop, laptop, tablet, or smartphone.

The advisor who sent them to the site through a unique link gets paid the commission for the sale! Our client advisors earn income 24/7 by driving traffic from social media, your warm market, and clients who prefer to get coverage on their own time, while still meeting with other clients virtually! Now you can leverage InsurTech for yourself.

You as the client advisor have access to real-time dashboards for status updates on all applications so that you can track how your 24/7 storefront is performing. We are empowering our agents with leading-edge systems and technology.

Advisor Compensation:

This is a 1099/commission-based position.

The average compensation is about $1,000 per issued client application. Our average full-time advisors will enroll at least five clients per week. Our top advisors will protect 15 to 20 clients per week. You will earn overrides, bonuses, residuals, and all-expense-paid incentive travel. You are vested from day one. This role sits at the intersection of client service, campaign operations, and account management. Our clients are primarily companies in the financial and investment sector seeking to acquire investors through email marketing campaigns. We run a broad portfolio of campaign types, including CPA, CPC, dedicated email sends, newsletter sponsorships, and other performance-based marketing programs.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management skills with commercial awareness and a passion for delivering excellent client outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients following contract execution.
  • Take over client relationships from the sales team and ensure a smooth onboarding process.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with clients and maintain a high level of client satisfaction.
  • Manage client expectations regarding campaign timelines, performance, and deliverables.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews and status updates with clients.
  • Identify opportunities for account growth and renewal.

Campaign Delivery & Operations

  • Coordinate campaign launches with internal scheduling and operations teams.
  • Ensure all campaign assets, targeting requirements, and technical specifications are received and approved.
  • Oversee the setup and execution of:
    • CPA campaigns
    • CPC campaigns
    • Dedicated email campaigns
    • Newsletter sponsorships
    • Other performance marketing initiatives
  • Monitor campaign pacing and delivery throughout the campaign lifecycle.
  • Proactively identify and resolve delivery issues, performance concerns, or operational bottlenecks.
  • Work closely with media buying, scheduling, and operations teams to maximize campaign performance.

Performance Management

  • Track campaign delivery against agreed objectives and KPIs.
  • Analyze campaign results and recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Ensure campaign commitments are fulfilled and documented.
  • Prepare campaign reports and client-facing performance summaries.
  • Escalate issues internally when intervention is required to meet delivery targets.

Commercial & Financial Management

  • Manage campaign reconciliations and delivery reporting.
  • Coordinate campaign settlement and invoicing processes with clients.
  • Verify campaign results and ensure accurate billing.
  • Support contract renewals and upsell opportunities through strong client service.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in account management, campaign management, client services, or customer success.
  • Experience in email marketing, digital advertising, lead generation, or media operations.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent client communication and relationship management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Experience working with performance-based advertising models such as CPA and CPC.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in financial marketing, investor acquisition, or capital markets-related campaigns.

Success Metrics

  • Client retention and satisfaction.

  • Resolution time for client issues and delivery challenges.
  • Renewal and expansion revenue from existing accounts.
  • Accuracy of campaign reporting and billing.

What We Offer

  • Performance-based bonus opportunities.
  • High level of ownership and client responsibility.
  • Exposure to financial services, investor marketing, and digital media.
  • Collaborative and entrepreneurial work environment.
  • Opportunity to grow into senior client services or operations leadership roles.

raw.description:
Job purpose:

Our client is looking for a proactive and technically strong accountant to join their Group Finance team, supporting the preparation and delivery of high-quality group financial reporting across multiple jurisdictions. This role will play a key part in the preparation of group consolidations and statutory financial statements, ensuring compliance with IFRS and supporting the wider business with technical accounting expertise.

You will work closely with internal finance teams, external auditors and other stakeholders to support the global audit process, improve reporting efficiencies and maintain a strong financial control environment. You will also be involved in financial reporting projects, implementation of new accounting standards, and supporting acquisitions to ensure alignment with group policies and statutory requirements.

Principal Accountabilities:

  • Preparation of group consolidation and financial statements (IFRS), Jersey & UK financial statements
  • Support in managing the global audit process; managing relationship with external auditors
  • Challenging processes used in the group consolidation, accounts preparation and audit process to identify and implement any improvements to efficiency and control
  • Establishing and maintaining effective relationships with internal jurisdictional financial controllers, tax and company secretarial teams as well as external auditors
  • Preparation of audit schedules and support including ad hoc technical accounting papers for board and auditors
  • Managing financial reporting projects such as the implementation of changes in accounting standards, ensuring compliance with IAS requirements
  • Provision of technical accounting expertise to the business including the development and maintenance of group wide accounting policies
  • Integration support to ensure acquisitions are aligned with group policies and statutory reporting requirements
  • Ensuring good control environment for group consolidation process
  • Other ad hoc projects or assistance to the wider group finance team as required

Our client is looking for a confident and resourceful experienced accountant with the following attributes and experience:

  • Audit background preferred but not essential for the right candidate
  • ACA/ACCA/CIMA qualified or part qualified
  • In depth working knowledge of IFRS
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Flexibility – ability to work in a team or individually; and to work to tight deadlines
  • Able to show and use initiative
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Confidence in challenging the status quo; suggesting and implementing practical improvements to jurisdictional and group wide processes
  • Competency with group consolidation finance systems and accounts productions systems preferred

title: UGC Program Manager, Social & Performance Creative

raw.title: UGC Program Manager, Social & Performance Creative
raw.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a proactive and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote UGC Program Manager, Social & Performance Creative opening.
raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a proactive and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote UGC Program Manager, Social & Performance Creative opening.

As the UGC Program Manager, Social & Performance Creative, you will build and scale the company's UGC and social media systems to support aggressive DTC growth goals. You will oversee the sourcing, coordination, and execution of UGC and video creatives for paid and organic channels, while helping strengthen the company's online presence, customer trust, and conversion performance across key touchpoints. You will contribute directly to the company's growth by ensuring a constant pipeline of high-quality creative assets, managing social media execution, and creating scalable processes and SOPs that allow the system to grow efficiently over time.

About the company:
The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.
Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Build & Scale UGC and Video Creative Production Pipeline

  • Build and manage a consistent UGC sourcing and production pipeline for paid ads, website assets, and social media content.
  • Coordinate creators, briefs, scripts, references, and deliverables to ensure a steady flow of high-quality video and photo assets.
  • Manage and organize creative assets, ensuring files are properly stored, categorized, and accessible for the marketing and DTC teams.
  • Collaborate with the DTC and creative teams to iterate on top-performing creatives and continuously improve performance.
  • Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines, customer positioning, and conversion goals.

Execute Social Media Content & Community Growth

  • Manage and grow the company's Facebook and Instagram presence through consistent posting and content execution.
  • Coordinate and publish organic social media content, including reels, posts, stories, and UGC-based assets.
  • Help strengthen customer trust and brand positioning through clear, engaging, and customer-focused content.
  • Monitor content performance and audience engagement, identifying opportunities for improvement and optimization.

Support Paid Social & Performance Creative

  • Collaborate with the DTC and paid media teams to develop UGC and social creatives optimized for Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ads.
  • Coordinate production and delivery of creatives that support ad testing, scaling, and conversion optimization efforts.
  • Assist in identifying winning creative angles, hooks, and content formats based on performance insights and feedback.

Create SOPs & Scalable Processes

  • Build and document clear SOPs and workflows for UGC sourcing, creator management, content production, asset organization, and publishing processes.
  • Help establish scalable systems that support long-term creative production and social media growth.
  • Continuously improve internal processes to increase efficiency, consistency, and execution quality.

Qualifications:

  • 1+ year of experience managing or coordinating UGC and video creative production for ads, social media, or eCommerce brands.
  • Preferred 1+ year of experience managing organic social media content and execution for Facebook and Instagram.
  • Preferred 1+ year of experience working with Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ad creatives and performance-focused content.
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of experience with additional paid or organic platforms such as TikTok or YouTube.
  • Experience coordinating creators, content production, or creative workflows in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Drive, Notion, Airtable, CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple moving parts, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changing priorities and conditions. Copes effectively with complexity and change.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: plans, organizes, schedules, and prioritizes work in an efficient and productive manner.
  • Enthusiasm: exhibits passion and excitement over work. Has a can-do attitude.
  • Creativity / Innovation: generates new and innovative approaches to problems and creative execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through UGC systems, social media execution, and performance creative support.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organized and proactive professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, enjoys building systems and coordinating creative execution, and is motivated by performance, continuous improvement, and long-term growth.

raw.title: Product Owner - ABS Commercial
raw.excerpt: Role OverviewGenus is building a modern IT function: clear product ownership, reliable platforms, and measurable outcomes for the business.
raw.description:
Role Overview

Genus is building a modern IT function: clear product ownership, reliable platforms, and measurable outcomes for the business. We’re looking for a Product Owner to join our ABS Commercial team and drive ongoing improvement across core operational and commercial processes.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of business operations and technology — shaping priorities, turning problems into deliverable work, and ensuring change lands well in the real world. You’ll be supported by an experienced business lead and a multidisciplinary team, with real scope to grow your product capability while taking meaningful ownership from day one.

You Will

The opportunityYou’ll take ownership of a prioritised improvement backlog focused on making operational and customer-facing processes simpler, faster and more reliable. Working with stakeholders across the business, delivery teams, solution architects and IT analysts, you’ll bring structure to demand, guide trade-offs, and keep work aligned to outcomes.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the improvement backlog: manage intake, shape demand, prioritise, and maintain clear roadmap visibility
  • Lead discovery with stakeholders: working with the Analysts, understand how the business operates, identify root causes, and define practical outcomes
  • Translate needs into epics/features/user stories with clear acceptance criteria and measurable success criteria
  • Coordinate delivery within an agile cadence, managing dependencies and keeping stakeholders aligned
  • Partner with architects and engineers to shape solutions that are pragmatic, supportable and scalable
  • Drive adoption: clear communication, readiness planning, feedback loops and continuous improvement
  • Track outcomes and benefits with the Business Stakeholders (what improved, how we measure it, what we do next)

Requirements

What we’re looking forWe’re looking for someone who can combine operational understanding with the discipline to deliver change through technology. You might come from product ownership, business analysis, process improvement, operations, or a similar background.

Key indicators include:

  • Strong grasp of how commercial and operational processes work end-to-end (order, fulfilment, inventory, customer service, planning, etc.)
  • Experience working with enterprise systems such as ERP and/or CRM, and the confidence to work with data, workflows and process design
  • Exposure to automation technologies (e.g., workflow automation, RPA, low-code, or similar) and how they enable real operational change
  • Proven ability to prioritise, make trade-offs clear, and follow through to delivery and adoption
  • Strong stakeholder management and clear communication — able to align different perspectives and maintain momentum

Business Overview

Genus is an agricultural biotechnology pioneer. We are a global FTSE 250 company, headquartered in the UK, and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Genus PLC has a presence in over 70 countries and a global workforce of over 3,000 employees and growing. We are a worldwide leader in porcine and bovine animal genetics, partnering with farmers to transform how we nourish the world – a mission that is important to a sustainable future.

Our vision is clear: Pioneering animal genetic improvement to sustainably nourish the world.

Our Values

  • Collaborate as One Team
  • Create Value for Customers
  • Innovate with Purpose
  • Never stop improving

DEI

Genus is a place where you can be yourself and be part of a growing global team. We have a culture of respect, openness and fairness for all. Whatever your background, your role or your area of work, you will have the chance to thrive in an environment that inspires, challenges and supports you to succeed.

Tackling Climate Change

  • Monitor and identify goals for the reduction of our GHG emissions from our own operations.
  • Drive porcine and bovine genetic improvements which support productivity gains and improve feed efficiency, enabling a reduction in the production of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions per unit of milk or meat produced
  • Identify facility and other opportunities for reductions in GHG emissions, consistent with our goals
  • Partner and advocate for policies that advance positive climate goals and identified United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Benefits Overview

  • Performance related bonus
  • 25 days holidays + Bank Holidays
  • Pension
  • Health Cash back scheme
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee share plan
  • Flexible Working Policy (Where appropriate/practicable)
  • Enhanced maternity leave 12 weeks at full pay followed by 4 weeks at 50% followed by SMP
  • Comprehensive L&D program including career development programs, access to Genus University and Mango (languages)

Equal Employment Opportunities

Genus is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with anti-discrimination law, it is the purpose of this policy to effectuate these principles and mandates. Genus prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Genus conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Genus plc will never ask you to provide fees or payment for computer, software, or other equipment or supplies during the recruitment and/or onboarding process. If you have any questions about your individual application, please contact the Genus Talent Acquisition team at .

raw.title: Accounting Operations Lead, UAE Compliance
raw.excerpt: About VyssorVyssor is a Dubai based corporate services firm helping founders and companies set up and operate in the UAE.
raw.description:
About Vyssor

Vyssor is a Dubai based corporate services firm helping founders and companies set up and operate in the UAE. We support clients across incorporation, visas, and ongoing financial compliance, with accounting as a core service line.

We are founder led, service driven, and remote first. Our reputation is built on accuracy, clear documentation, and hitting every deadline. We operate at pace, with a lean team, clear ownership, and high trust.

About the role

The Accounting Operations Lead owns the delivery and quality of bookkeeping and accounting compliance for Vyssor and its clients. This role ensures records are accurate, complete, and audit ready. It also ensures VAT and Corporate Tax obligations are met on time, every time.

This is not a transactional finance role only. It is a compliance execution and control role. You will enforce standards, lead the accounting team, and prevent problems before they hit deadlines.

Reporting line: CEO

Scope: Client bookkeeping oversight, VAT and Corporate Tax filings, internal accounting compliance, team leadership, process control, tooling and visibility.

About you

You are structured, deadline obsessed in a healthy way, and allergic to messy books. You know how UAE compliance works in the real world, not just in theory. You lead through clear standards, tight follow up, and calm execution.

You can manage a portfolio, manage a team, and manage risk. You communicate clearly with founders and non finance stakeholders, without turning it into a lecture. You protect scope, protect quality, and protect the business from compliance surprises.

Top 5 objectives:

  1. Bring full visibility to all client and internal compliance deadlines: Create or clean a single source of truth for VAT and Corporate Tax calendars, filings, and dependencies.

  2. Raise bookkeeping quality to audit ready standards across the portfolio: Implement review routines, checklists, and minimum documentation standards. Eliminate recurring errors.

  3. Stabilize VAT and Corporate Tax execution: Ensure every filing is prepared, reviewed, and submitted on time. Build a repeatable workflow with clear handoffs.

  4. Standardize client dossiers and SOPs: Create consistent folder structures, naming conventions, audit trails, and SOPs across client types and free zones.

  5. Improve team execution speed without quality loss: Clarify roles, priorities, and escalation paths. Coach the team. Build accountability and reduce bottlenecks.

Other responsibilities:

Client bookkeeping and compliance delivery

  • Oversee and review bookkeeping for client entities based on client provided documentation

  • Ensure compliance with UAE accounting standards, VAT requirements, and Corporate Tax obligations

  • Prepare, review, and submit VAT returns and Corporate Tax filings

  • Ensure records are complete, consistent, and audit ready

  • Act as escalation point for complex cases and technical questions

  • Ensure delivery stays within the agreed service scope. Flag scope creep early

Deadline and regulatory management

  • Own filing calendars, trackers, and status reporting

  • Proactively identify risks related to missing data, delays, or regulatory changes

  • Escalate compliance risks to management before deadlines are impacted

  • Maintain internal discipline around cutoffs and client input timelines

Internal accounting. Vyssor entities

  • Oversee bookkeeping and compliance for Vyssor internal entities

  • Coordinate AP and AR processes to ensure accurate reflection in the books

  • Prepare internal accounting summaries for management review

  • Apply the same standards internally as we apply to clients

Process and quality control

  • Own SOPs, checklists, and internal accounting guidelines

  • Maintain structured client dossiers, documentation trails, and audit evidence

  • Standardize workflows across different free zones and client categories

  • Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements. Automate where sensible

Team leadership and oversight

  • Lead and supervise the accounting team responsible for bookkeeping and filings

  • Assign, prioritize, and review work for accuracy, completeness, and deadlines

  • Support onboarding and training. Set clear expectations and standards

  • Drive accountability through consistent review cadence and performance feedback

Systems, CRM, and tools

  • Ensure consistent use of accounting software and CRM tracking

  • Preferably Zoho, but equivalent systems are fine if you can adapt quickly

  • Maintain visibility over client status, missing requirements, and upcoming filings

  • Collaborate with operations or systems support to improve workflows and automation

Client interaction when needed

  • Join client calls when senior accounting expertise is required

  • Support the team in sensitive compliance discussions

  • Explain bookkeeping, VAT, and Corporate Tax topics clearly to non finance stakeholders

Main requirements:

  • Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

  • Proven experience in bookkeeping oversight and compliance delivery

  • Strong working knowledge of UAE VAT and Corporate Tax filing requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and reliable deadline management

  • Experience working with accounting software, CRM tools, and structured documentation

  • Strong written and verbal English

  • Comfortable working in a service driven environment with clear scope boundaries

Nice to have

  • Prior experience in an accounting firm, corporate services provider, or multi entity client environment

  • Experience leading teams and setting operating rhythms

  • Familiarity with Zoho ecosystems: CRM, Books, analytics, automation

  • Audit preparation experience and strong documentation discipline

What success looks like

  • No missed deadlines. No surprises

  • Clean files. Clear audit trails. Consistent client dossiers

  • A team that executes with structure and confidence

  • Leadership can see the full portfolio status at a glance

  • Clients experience Vyssor as organized, responsive, and reliable
